---
id: SQC-1
title: "An agent started in any nested repo worktree of a run can find and navigate the shared knowledge base: one index that reaches every file, a stated path root, and the existing knowledge validator extended to enforce it"
status: in_progress
depends_on: []
acceptance_criteria:
  - id: SQC-1-AC1
    text: 'The existing relative-link check of the knowledge validator (`validate_relative_links` in `scripts/check_knowledge_docs.py`, run by `uv run check-knowledge-docs`, `task docs:check-knowledge-docs`, the pre-commit hook and the CI job `lint-knowledge-docs`) also covers `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, every `.md` under `docs/`, `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/rules/`, not only the 65 files under `knowledge/`. A link that does not resolve to an existing file is reported with the check name `relative-link` and the file that holds it. Anchors stay unchecked: the pages in `docs/standards/` are mkdocs snippet includes (`--8<--`), so an anchor such as `writing-standard.md#2-where-the-standard-does-not-apply` in `docs/standards/index.md` cannot be checked in the file it names. Baseline at HEAD 8d7327b: 274 relative links in 106 Markdown files, 0 broken, so the real workspace must still report none. A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC1_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC1")` builds a temporary workspace with one dead link in each of `AGENTS.md`, a `SKILL.md`, a `docs/` page and a `.claude/rules/` file and expects one `relative-link` failure for each, and runs `validate_documents` on the real workspace and expects no `relative-link` failure. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC1` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC2
    text: 'The validator has a new check named `path-reference`, part of `validate_documents`. Every file path written in `knowledge/**/*.md`, `docs/**/*.md`, `.claude/skills/**/*.md`, `.claude/rules/**/*.md`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` (in backticks, in tables or in plain text, outside fenced code blocks) that starts with `knowledge/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `.claude/skills/` or `.claude/rules/` and ends in a file extension exists when resolved from the workspace root. A path inside a nested repo is written with its `repos/<repo>/` prefix, which is not checked (`repos/` is gitignored and absent in CI and in a run''s mirror). Paths with `<`, `*`, `XXXX`, `YYYY` or `X.Y.Z`, and the prefix `.claude/scratch/` (created when a skill writes), are skipped. Baseline at HEAD: 140 paths checked, 19 unresolved in 5 files. knowledge/references/workflows.md has 13 (lines 292-302 and 320-321 say `docs/references/...`, `docs/templates/...`, `docs/architecture/...` for files that live in `knowledge/`). `knowledge/references/08-faq-patterns.md:38` and `knowledge/sdlc/parked-aurora-dms-cutover-mrs.md:185` name `scripts/deploy_views.py` and `scripts/deploy_triggers.py`, files of other repos. `knowledge/references/07-gotchas-exceptions.md:157` names tests/auto_approval/detection/test_cf_dna_auto_approvals.py, a file of a nested repo. `knowledge/sdlc/parked-aurora-dms-cutover-mrs.md:63` names knowledge/sdlc/adrs/ADR-0015-aurora-serverless-v2-us-east-1.md, which that page says is untracked on another branch. `.claude/rules/README.md:46` names scripts/check-comment-hygiene.sh, a script of Clara''s workspace. Each is fixed by correcting the path, adding `repos/<repo>/`, or rewording so a file that does not exist here is not written as a workspace path. A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC2_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC2")` expects a `path-reference` failure for an unresolved path in a temporary workspace (not for a path in a fenced block, a `repos/` path, a placeholder or a `.claude/scratch/` path) and no `path-reference` failure on the real workspace. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC2` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC3
    text: 'The validator has a new check named `reachability`, part of `validate_documents`: following relative Markdown links between `.md` files, starting at `knowledge/00-master-reference.md`, reaches every `.md` file under `knowledge/`. The existing `orphan` check stays as it is (it accepts a mention in `AGENTS.md`, a skill or any README, and lets a folder README stand for its folder; it never asks that those READMEs are themselves linked). Baseline at HEAD: 65 files, 48 reachable, 17 not: `knowledge/development/README.md` and `01-lambda-layers-dependency-management.md`; `knowledge/sdlc/adrs/README.md` and ADR-0001 to ADR-0008 and ADR-0014 (ADR-0013 is reachable); `knowledge/sdlc/requirements/README.md`, `srs/fr/kafka-producer-v2.md` and `srs/nfr/kafka-producer-v2.md`; `knowledge/sdlc/parked-aurora-dms-cutover-mrs.md`; `knowledge/templates/04-release-mr-description.md`. In addition the master reference''s Skills table links every `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`: 11 skills exist and 5 are listed (`analyze`, `plan`, `lookup`, `verify`, `debug`); `bump-schemas`, `implement`, `release-manifest`, `release-mrs`, `retro` and `review` are missing. A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC3_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC3")` expects a `reachability` failure naming a file that no link chain from the master reference reaches in a temporary workspace, and on the real workspace expects no `reachability` failure and a link to each skill file in the master reference. A new knowledge file or skill makes it fail until it is indexed. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC3` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC4
    text: '`AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` each contain the path `knowledge/00-master-reference.md` (as a link or in backticks); `CLAUDE.md` has none today and `AGENTS.md` has it once. `AGENTS.md` has a heading `## Finding the knowledge base` whose section says: every `knowledge/`, `.claude/` and `repos/` path in `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, the skills and the knowledge files is relative to the workspace root, the folder that holds `AGENTS.md`; from a repo at `repos/<x>` the root is `../..` and from a repo at `repos/<group>/<x>` it is `../../..`, or walk up from the working directory to the first folder that holds `knowledge/00-master-reference.md`; and to open `knowledge/00-master-reference.md` first. The section also states that a path under `repos/` is a sibling clone, read-only unless the task names it. A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC4_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC4")` checks the two paths, the heading, and the literals `../..`, `../../..`, `repos/<x>`, `repos/<group>/<x>` in that section. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC4` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC5
    text: 'Every `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` (11 files) has YAML frontmatter with a non-empty `name` equal to its folder name and a non-empty `description` (omp skips a skill without one), and contains the sentence `Paths are relative to the workspace root` followed in the same paragraph by a link `[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md#finding-the-knowledge-base)`, so the rule stands in the file that an agent reads and the link resolves from any working directory. The commands in the Skills table of `CLAUDE.md` are exactly the skill folders: today it lists 12 commands for 11 folders, because `/config` has no `.claude/skills/config/`; that skill was deleted on purpose in commit efa5413 (which also edited `CLAUDE.md`), so its table row and the `/config` line in `README.md` are removed and the skill is not restored. Baseline: 9 of 11 skills name `knowledge/` paths (57 references; `implement` and `bump-schemas` name none), 10 name `.claude/scratch/` outputs (56 references; `lookup` has none), and no skill says what its paths are relative to; all their `knowledge/` paths resolve from the root and none from `repos/<x>` (AC2 covers resolution). A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC5_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC5")` checks frontmatter, the sentence, the link target and the table against the folders, and names the skill that fails. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC5` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC6
    text: 'The structure tree in `knowledge/README.md` is rooted at `knowledge/` (today it shows `not:docs/00-master-reference.md`, `not:docs/architecture/`, `not:docs/references/`, `not:docs/workflows/`, `not:docs/operations/`, `not:docs/templates/`), lists every sub-folder of `knowledge/` that exists (`architecture`, `development`, `incidents`, `operations`, `references`, `sdlc`, `templates`, `workflows`; `development`, `incidents` and `sdlc` are missing today), and every (N docs) count it prints equals the number of `.md` files under that folder, README files and sub-folders included (it says architecture 17, references 11, templates 3; there are 19, 13 and 4; workflows 5 is right). It names `AGENTS.md#finding-the-knowledge-base` next to its existing pointer to `AGENTS.md` under Getting Started. A pytest named `test_SQC_1_AC6_*` marked `@pytest.mark.ac("SQC-1-AC6")` parses the tree lines and compares folders and counts with the file system. `uv run pytest tests -k SQC_1_AC6` exits 0'
  - id: SQC-1-AC7
    manual: true
    text: "The human proves the whole path on a real nested worktree. After the run, in the run's workspace: `ark worktree create <run> repos/qc-workflow-mocker repos/common-libraries/qc-thresholding` (one repo at `repos/<x>`, one at `repos/<group>/<x>`; both on `main`, nothing is pushed). The human starts `omp` with `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5` in each of the two worktrees, without naming any path, and asks: `Which document explains how lib_source_type and qc_type map to the sample types, and which lib_source_type value does a tumor DNA sample have?` Each agent opens the shared index (`knowledge/00-master-reference.md` or `AGENTS.md`), reaches `knowledge/references/02-sample-type-mappings.md` through it, and answers `DnaTumor` from that file with its real path; the human compares the answer with the file. Answer `ok` with `ark gate record <run> manual SQC-1-AC7 ok --note <text>` naming the two worktrees; any wrong or guessed answer, or an agent that never read the index, is `problem` with the transcript path in the note"
